files.assessment-contract.json:
{
  "schemaVersion": 1,
  "kind": "http-driver-headroom-assessment-contract",
  "windowPolicy": {
    "windowMs": 10000,
    "minimumRequestsPerWindow": 50,
    "minimumP99Requests": 1000
  },
  "wholeMeasurementMinimumCorrect": 1000,
  "driverPressureSignals": {
    "analyzerAbsoluteProcessCpuCores": 0.8,
    "wholePhaseElu": 0.8,
    "additionalProcessCpuFractionOfDeclaredQuota": 0.8,
    "droppedOrLateGreaterThan": 0,
    "originalAnalyzerGate": "preserve averageCpuCores>0.8 OR eventLoopUtilization>0.8 and all original run.issues; quota normalization never replaces or clears it"
  },
  "warmupReview": {
    "windows": "all 3 warmup and 12 measurement windows, independently per case/arm/block",
    "candidateComparison": "last two complete warmup vs first two complete measurement windows, and all measurement trend",
    "comparisonDefinition": "for each metric separately: reference=median of last 2 warmup window order statistics; candidate=median of first 2 measurement window order statistics; absolute difference vs max(1ms, 0.1*reference); descriptive only, not a pooled latency quantile",
    "p50AndP95DescriptiveDifferenceBudget": {
      "relative": 0.1,
      "absoluteMs": 1
    },
    "minimumPerMetric": 50,
    "p99LowSamples": "unknown; never use per-window observedNearestRank P99 as stable"
  },
  "cpuComparison": "same case/rate/block; target fixed; CPU1 vs CPU2 affects quota only, not Node event-loop count",
  "requiredEvidence": [
    "first complete collector sample before HTTP, controlled-stop + terminal + independent role/quota verification before anchor cleanup",
    "complete original stdout JVM parse and independent same-raw replay; source/PID/boot/ready binding",
    "full analyzer raw verification and exact suite answers/service checks",
    "original profile/benchmark/source/build/settings + actual target/driver inspect and pre/post mode",
    "zero errors/answer mismatches, no cancellation/budget exhaustion; preserve late/dropped as pressure",
    "phase whole-driver CPU/ELU/eventLoopDelay/RSS + window validation/scheduler-delay/latency/counts",
    "complete 12-arm denominator; skipped/failed cells remain explicit unknown or invalid"
  ],
  "reviewStates": [
    "not-executed",
    "consistent-descriptive-candidate",
    "drift-or-pressure-observed",
    "unknown",
    "invalid"
  ],
  "stopRules": [
    "cancel/evidence corruption/wrong answer/service-check failure/OOM/disk floor/work cap/unknown ownership: stop entire operation",
    "do not exceed per-arm target512MiB/raw512MiB/analysis96MiB/command64MiB/collector32MiB/JVM8+32MiB/proof2MiB or operation16GiB; retain partial evidence",
    "if either member shows late/dropped, original analyzer absoluteCPU>0.8 or ELU>0.8, finish its safe matching CPU member; mark higher rates not-executed for both blocks; CPU/quota is additional only",
    "never change rates/concurrency/thresholds or replace a physical arm; lower safe cells in block2 may still run",
    "fixed executor records the pair decision before any higher-rate dispatch; no replacement arms"
  ],
  "boundaries": [
    "offered range only 10..40rps; no requirement to find saturation or upper capacity",
    "inFlight4 matches AA005; three cases and rates10..40 do not qualify an all-eleven or wider-rate study",
    "CPU2 no improvement alone cannot prove driver headroom; one Node loop, target limits and co-host interference can mask effects",
    "phase counters include drain; no per-window CPU attribution or cross-process clocks/resources",
    "2 blocks support descriptive repeat observations, not formal confidence/equivalence acceptance",
    "shared host/protected d6/VM contention disclosed; no whole-host exclusivity or server-capacity attribution"
  ],
  "observationStratum": "AA005 same fixed target/JVM/collector/IF4 with validation enabled; driver CPU1 vs CPU2 is the explicit single variable; only three cases/rates10..40",
  "performanceAccepted": false,
  "warmupStable": null,
  "driverHeadroomAccepted": null,
  "serverCapacityUpperBound": null,
  "qualificationAccepted": false
}
